q: How much CO2 does a chemical dryer save by switching a wood-fired hot air generator to gas?
title: Wood to gas hot air generator: CO2 effect
short: It raises your reported fossil CO2, by about 35 t a year on BEE's Ahmedabad figures. A 30,000 kcal/h gas unit replaces 130 t of wood with 14,940 Nm3 of gas and adds 6,040 kWh. Wood CO2 is biogenic and reported separately, so the report's 93 t cut does not belong in Scope 1.
audience: Owners of chemical, dye and pigment units in Ahmedabad and similar clusters drying product in tray dryers on wood-fired hot air generators

ul: A wood-fired hot air generator feeding one 200-tray dryer burns about 36 kg of wood an hour, around 130 t a year.
Measured heat out was 35,964 kcal/h against 97,200 kcal/h of wood in, an efficiency of about 37%.
The proposed 30,000 kcal/h gas unit burns 4.15 Nm3 an hour, 14,940 Nm3 a year, with a 2 hp blower and air out at up to 150 C.
Electricity rises by about 6,040 kWh a year.
Project cost Rs 2.50 lakh, saving Rs 0.76 lakh a year, simple payback 3.29 years, at 2010 prices.

sections.h: Why the report's 93 t cut is not yours to claim
p: The report counts 130 t of wood as 123 t of CO2 avoided, subtracts 30 t for the gas, and calls the difference a 93 t reduction. Under the GHG Protocol, CO2 from burning wood is biogenic: you report it separately, outside the Scope 1 total. Gas is fossil and goes inside it.

So the switch takes your Scope 1 from close to zero for this dryer to about 31 t, and Scope 2 up by about 4 t. Methane and nitrous oxide from burning wood do stay in Scope 1, but they are small, so removing them barely moves the total.

ul: Steady air temperature, which the report links to drying quality.
No wood logs to store, size and feed by hand.
Less pressure on local forests, which the report flags because much of the wood is not from renewable sources.
If the wood is cut from forest that is not replanted, write that in a note to your inventory. Do not net it off your Scope 1 figure.

sections.h: What to check before you order
ul: Gas supply and pressure for 4.15 Nm3 an hour at your site, and a separate gas meter on the new unit.
Whether your supplier bills in Nm3 (at 0 C) or scm (usually 15 C); the two differ by about 5%.
Your own wood use per hour over a full week, weighed, before you compare running costs at today's prices.

example.title: One 200-tray dryer for a year, before and after
lines: Before: 130 t of wood. CO2 from it is biogenic, reported separately. Fossil CO2 for this dryer: close to zero
After, gas: 14,940 Nm3 x 2.05 kg CO2 per m3 = 30.6 t CO2 (Scope 1)
After, extra power: 6,040 kWh x 0.675 = 4.1 t CO2 (Scope 2)
Change in reported fossil CO2: about 34.7 t more a year
example.note: Gas at our natural gas factor of 2.05 kg CO2 per cubic metre; LNG delivered as gas is natural gas. Grid factor is CEA's for FY 2025-26. Both are estimates.

senseible: Senseible reads your gas and electricity bills and gives monthly CO2 for each with the factor named, so the effect of a dryer switch shows up line by line in your records. The green loan check shows what a lender will want to see for the new unit.
